source: In-game STNS panels for the six CX stations, six buffers read in one sitting and screenshotted. `commissionedDaysAgo` is the panel's own 'Commissioned' field, which prints whole days and carries no hour.
observedOnPrecision: the date this was transcribed into the repo; the screenshot's own capture instant was not recorded, and every conclusion drawn from these figures slides one KI-439b/d alias step per 5.7182 real days of error in it

conventions.commissionedDaysAgo: whole real days before the observation instant, as printed
conventions.tolerance: +-1 day, the user's stated confidence, wider than the panel's own rounding

universeStart.basis: the four founding exchanges all read 2,000 days, so the figure dates the universe rather than any one station
universeStart.note: 109.51 = 2000 x 20 / 365.25, the age in game years the 20x ratio implies

corroboration: The two later stations share a single distinct value, 1,643 days, 357 days after the founding four. Two tiers rather than one flat number is what says the field is a real commissioning timestamp and not a placeholder, which is the whole reason the 2,000 can be leaned on.
